ModMetaData.name: Droidworks
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The one droid platform: every droid in the Ash'karr campaign on a single independent framework. Five states (functional / ion-stunned / powered-down / unbootable / catastrophic detonation), shop-centric repair, embodied software, restraining bolts with consequences, faction-keyed data spikes.
Private campaign mod, not for redistribution.
CREDITS — this mod absorbs and retires, with gratitude, content and ideas from: - Star Wars KotOR Droids by guy762 (droid models, backstories, module slots) - Outer Rim - Droid Depot by Neronix17 (droid models; Asimov framework ideas: restraining bolt, memory wipe, reprogramming) - [JDS] StarWars - The Separatist Droid Army by JangoD'soul and Criz (Separatist droid models) - Artificial Beings Framework / Synstructs by Killathon (charging, formatting, inert-state and directive design) All mechanics are original implementations; art is carried for private play and being progressively regenerated.
